name: RFC
about: Propose a change to the data model, integrity rules, schema, conformance levels or passport format
title: "RFC: "
labels: rfc
---

## Summary

One paragraph: what changes.

## Motivation

The problem, with a concrete case. What goes wrong today?

## Proposal

The normative text as it would appear in the specification, with the sections it changes.

## Schema, examples and fixtures

What changes in `schema/`, `examples/` and `fixtures/`, including new or changed rule IDs.

## Compatibility

Which existing records, producers or validators stop conforming, and how they migrate.

## Alternatives

What else was considered and why it was not chosen.
